title: Disco
lyrics:
[00:11.75]I can't help it with you
[00:17.09]Stubborn hearted blue
[00:22.80]Lights come into the room
[00:28.06]When disco plays our tune
[00:33.48]'Cause there's nothing like it, not like the way you move
[00:39.44]I can try, but I can't hide it from you
[00:44.85]'Cause I can't wait for you
[00:50.56]I can't wait for you
[01:06.89]Admire all of you
[01:12.47]But fire burns me too
[01:17.28]Can't stop that disco getting through
[01:22.84]Can't stop that disco wanting you
[01:28.94]'Cause there's nothing like it, locking my eyes with you
[01:34.95]I can't fight it, splitting my mind in two
[01:40.20]'Cause I can't wait for you
[01:46.14]I can't wait for you
[01:51.59]I can't wait for you
[01:57.17]I can't wait for you
